text:
Sarah: RFC follow-up: we need a concrete default for tenant private connectivity. two options: place private endpoints in customer VPC (direct) or terminate into our tenant-proxy fleet (proxied). need to pick default and failure/fallback semantics.

Matt: constraints from product/sales: predictable latency, simple onboarding for customers with partner ACLs, and clear costing.

Oliver: direct gives lowest hop-count and preserves source IP for egress ACLs. downside = explosion of cross-account endpoints and more peering surface to manage.

Devon: proxy centralizes telemetry, lets us do caching/batching and graceful rollouts, but adds a hop and extra infra to operate. brings easier fallback too.

Priya: SRE note: direct-only means no easy automatic fallback if customer's route changes. proxy gives us a safe fallback path we can route to during customer-side failures.

Sarah: propose hybrid default: prefer direct when healthy, automatically fail to proxy on health/latency/error signals. allow explicit direct-only or proxy-only flags per customer for compliance/partner needs.

Matt: suggest numbers to start with: prefer direct if sustained <200 rps and <5k tokens/minute; recommend proxy when >200 rps sustained or customer requests batching/caching.

Oliver: failure detect idea: if p95 proxy path latency >120ms for 20s OR proxy error rate >2% for 1m, then fail to direct when available. also circuit-breaker for proxy saturation.

Devon: routing config example:
```yaml
connectivity:
  default: prefer_direct_with_proxy_fallback
  direct_threshold_rps: 200
  proxy_fail_latency_ms: 120
  proxy_fail_window_s: 20
  forced_direct_tags: ["egress-ip-preservation", "partner-acl"]
  proxy_only_tags: ["data-residency-required"]
```

Priya: ops items: tag traces path=direct|proxy, add proxy instance id, autoscale groups with 30% headroom, dashboards for split rate and p95 per path, runbook for proxy->direct failover.

Sarah: security/certs: two modes supported: (1) mTLS end-to-end with proxy as TCP passthrough, (2) TLS terminate at proxy with attestation token to control plane. document tradeoffs and let customers pick via onboarding.

Matt: sales asks: include cost comparison in recommendation docs (infra vs ops).

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-3412: "Tenant connectivity default: prefer-direct-with-proxy-fallback + followups" assigned to Sarah, Devon, Oliver, Priya, Matt.

Devon: i'll run a perf sim (1000 tenants mixed load) and post numbers by Thu.

Sarah: thanks everyone. i'll draft the decision appendix + onboarding checklist updates and sync Fri. :thumbsup:
